content: We are what we repeatedly do; excellence, then, is not an isolated act, but a steady habit.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: You do not become an honest person by telling the truth once every blue moon; you become honest because truth-telling is your reflexive default. Character is merely the compound interest of small, automatic, non-negotiable daily habits.
practicalInsight: Choose one habit that embodies the person you wish to be—punctuality, tidiness, or deep listening—and perform it without fail today.
reflectionPrompt: What daily habit are you repeatedly performing that is actively undermining your aspirations?
